response:
It sounds like you're dealing with a lot right now, and it's understandable to feel confused and worried when someone you love is behaving so unpredictably. The kind of dramatic shifts you're describing—from very energized to very down—can sometimes point to a genuine mental health condition rather than "acting out." These patterns are real and can feel overwhelming for everyone in the household, including you.

Because I can't diagnose what's going on, the most helpful step would be encouraging your mom to see a doctor or mental health professional who can properly evaluate her. If she's open to it, offering to help her make an appointment can make a big difference. And please don't overlook your own wellbeing—talking to a trusted adult, counselor, or supportive friend can help you cope with the stress at home. If your mom ever seems in immediate danger or talks about harming herself, reach out to emergency services or a crisis line right away.
